chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Every predatory animal with fangs and every bird with talons is unlawful."

key_terms.السِّبَاعِ: beasts of prey or predatory animals
key_terms.ذِي نَابٍ: possessing a fang, referring to predatory animals
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.مِخْلَبٍ: a talon or claw used by predatory birds

ai.seo_question: Which animals and birds are considered haram to eat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that forbids consuming predatory beasts that possess fangs and birds that possess talons. It is a concise Prophetic tradition used in fiqh discussions on halal and haram foods, especially in the chapter of hunting and slaughtering.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4147 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Every predatory animal with fangs and every bird with talons is unlawful."
